news.title: Launching new branding packages
news.excerpt: Introducing comprehensive branding solutions for businesses of all sizes
news.content: We're excited to announce our new comprehensive branding packages designed to help businesses of all sizes establish a strong visual identity. From logo design to complete brand systems, our packages are tailored to meet your specific needs and budget.

news.title: Case study: Rainbow Enterprise rebrand
news.excerpt: How we transformed a local furniture brand's digital presence
news.content: Rainbow Enterprise approached us looking to revitalize their brand presence in the competitive furniture market. Through strategic design and consistent visual identity, we helped them achieve a 300% increase in social media engagement and stronger brand recognition.

news.title: Expanding our service offerings
news.excerpt: New services including app design and marketing videos
news.content: Based on client demand and market trends, we've expanded our service offerings to include mobile app design, marketing video production, and comprehensive social media management packages.
